metadata.case_name: LEUNG HON KIT v. WONG PO HING AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Intra-articular fracture of the right distal radius
source: X-ray showed fracture of right distal radius
intra-articular fracture of the right distal radius ... that there had been moderate displacement of the radial fracture.
the fracture distal radius had united with significant displacement/malunion
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

injuries.description: Fracture of right ulnar styloid at the base with subsequent non-union
source: fractures at right distal radius and ulnar styloid shown by X-ray
fracture right ulnar styloid at the base
the fracture ulnar styloid had resulted in non-union
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: Pain in right wrist (ulnar side, volar and dorsal aspects), increasing after exertion
Residual stiffness and diminished range of motion of right wrist
Weakness of right hand and decreased endurance (needs rest after half an hour or an hour)
Numbness of right hand and feeling of right hand and wrist being covered/bound
Reduced right hand grip strength (right 19 kgf, left 42 kgf)
Diagnosis of Adjustment Disorder with Depressed Mood

treatments_received: Closed reduction and short arm slab
25 physiotherapy outpatient sessions (transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation, ice, magnetopulse therapy, active mobilization exercises)
Ulnar gutter splint and based finger splint
Pulsed radiofrequency lesioning of right median and ulnar nerve (29 October 2013)
Regular psychiatric medications and psychiatric outpatient treatment
treatments_future: Osteotomy surgery to correct malunion (recommended but plaintiff refused)

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulties in hair washing, key turning and door pushing

Reduction in work capacity with decrease in strength, dexterity and endurance affecting ability to work as a cook (need to rest after half an hour or an hour; unable to perform full duties as a casual construction site worker)
Adjustment Disorder with Depressed Mood causing mild impairment (depressive mood, nightmare, palpitation, poor sleep)

comparable_cases.case_name: Tsui Kwan Fai v Goldfield N & W Construction Company Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: Multiple injuries to his face, right upper limb and right shoulder, with X-ray showing a fracture of the head of the right radius; soft tissue injuries in right wrist and right shoulder; ceased playing basketball and rock climbing.

comparable_cases.case_name: Cheng Yuk Chun v Winson Cleaning Service Company & Ors
comparable_cases.injury_description: Bruises to forehead, 1-cm nasal bridge laceration, fracture of the right distal radius treated with closed reduction and plaster immobilization; developed Reflex Sympathetic Dystrophy (RSD), MRI showed TFC tear, mild carpal tunnel syndrome; later wrist arthroscopy and debridement.
